top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a dated, reproducible discovery (2009 P-granule droplets by Brangwynne and Hyman, 2012 multivalent reconstitution by Rosen) with a quantitative physical-chemical mechanism: multivalency-driven liquid-liquid demixing. It organises a large body of biochemistry and has opened new questions and tools. The citation is limited to the principle and claims nothing about specific in vivo condensates, which answers the maturity objection. P002 is the clean fallback, though a PROTAC-only citation omits the cereblon and glue lineage and no PROTAC drug is yet approved.
